reviews.title: Good fit
reviews.comment:
Good fit. Easy to install.  Did not have number of cables that were posted in product ie only one pcie cable when it shows two on product page.
Update 30jun2025: power supply fried my motherboard tried on another computer power supply did not work thankfully it did not fry that motherboard did all trouble shooting had to send back motherboard and buy a new one, time went by by the time I finished build to send back power supply hoping it didn't fry my cpu will find out soon
